Returns the median value of sorted array in case of N is even. Result = (Sorted_array[N/2] + Sorted_array[(N/2) - 1] ) / 2 For example: Sorted_array[4] = [8.0, 10.0, 15.0, 42.0] Result = (15.0 + 10.0) / 2.0 = 12.5
